request.subject: UNIT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Redraw him as a high-medieval man-at-arms: a deep crimson red surcoat with a bold gold-yellow cross on the chest and a gold hem, over steel chainmail sleeves; the round shield becomes a pointed heater shield painted crimson red with a gold-yellow lion; a gold band around the steel helmet under the crimson crest. Keep the face, sword, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the feet.
